sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list does not include hydrocodone bitartrate and acetaminophen as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale East holds 263 tablets at 15.7 per day, providing 16.7 days on hand.
Corvale General holds 558 tablets at 19.4 per day, providing 28.8 days on hand.
Corvale Lakeside holds 59 tablets at 4.8 per day, providing 12.4 days on hand.
The top-ranked purchasing option is to buy from Alvogen Inc., which is not on FDA's shortage list today.
Alvogen Inc.'s label names no plant we could place for supply verification.
Proficient Rx LP, a repackager linked to this product, received VAI classifications in 2015 and 2022.
